recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群單一的中大型細胞，核為圓形、染色質細緻，周圍有中等量灰藍色、帶細小顆粒的細胞質，符合以圓核單核母細胞為主的急性單核球性白血病。
features: Monotonous medium to large cells with round nuclei
Fine, finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous small nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Occasional cell with slightly indented nucleus
Few admixed mature elements; background of red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of medium to large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, surrounded by a moderate rim of gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules. Occasional nuclei are slightly indented. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia; round-nucleated monoblasts should be confirmed with NSE cytochemistry and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have a higher N:C ratio with MPO-positive granules and Auer rods, accompanied by maturing neutrophils.
AMML contains at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells with MPO positivity, unlike this monotonous monocytic population.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO/NSE negative with TdT expression.
